dimensions.assessment: The review covers technical assistance available to States, Tribes, local governments, and non-governmental organizations, as well as economically distressed communities.
dimensions.evidence: available to States, Tribes, local governments, and non-governmental organizations

dimensions.assessment: The effects are administrative in nature, requiring reports, reviews, and compliance planning rather than changing day-to-day life for citizens.
dimensions.evidence: directs the Government Accountability Office (GAO) to review the technical assistance authority

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state specific dollar amounts for federal spending or revenue changes.
The bill directs agency reporting and administrative reviews rather than establishing new broad programs or regulatory powers.
dimensions.evidence: directs the Government Accountability Office (GAO) to review the technical assistance authority

dimensions.assessment: Requires a one-time GAO report and annual EPA compliance plans for a period of five years.
dimensions.evidence: annually thereafter for a period of 5 years

missing_information: Exact fiscal costs or appropriations required to conduct the GAO review and EPA reporting.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates a GAO review of EPA clean water technical assistance programs and requires annual compliance plans from the EPA for five years, primarily affecting federal agencies and select communities without creating new broad regulatory mandates or spending programs.
